zh.place: 半月酒吧 烛光下的吧台

zh: 黑。伸手不见五指。只剩外面哗哗的雨声。
还有手腕上那只手。很烫，抓得很紧。
都站着别动。Nico，蜡烛放哪儿了？

zh.hint: 黑暗里有人一直攥着你的手腕，没出声。你看不见是谁。

opts.t: 反手握住那只手
then: Nico的心跳快得像要从嘴里蹦出来。
那只手的拇指，在他腕骨上轻轻蹭了一下。

opts.t: 第二个抽屉！我去拿！
then: 那只手一下子松开了，像被烫到一样。

zh: 咔哒一声，Rowan打着了打火机，点亮第一根蜡烛。
烛光一晃。Nico低头——抓着他手腕的人，是Theo。
Theo立刻松手，把手插回裤兜，脸转向一边。
干嘛？我还不能当回好人了？
Nico从储物间抱出一整箱香薰蜡烛。老周去年进的，一根没卖出去。
薰衣草味的？你这是酒吧还是足疗店？
挺好，有氛围。就差一个求婚的了。
话一出口，Theo自己先呛了一下。
蜡烛点了一圈，墙上的钟：11点40。大家围着吧台坐下。

then: Theo把手机亮给大家看：航班还显示“正常”。
看见没？老天爷都催我走。
他说得特轻松，挑了个离Nico最远的位子。
地下室里，是Nico亲口让他去的。现在Nico心里堵得慌。
Theo一屁股坐在Nico旁边，膝盖挨着膝盖。
可刚才那只手，比蜡烛还烫。
else: Nico，开瓶最贵的。反正以后没人跟你抢单了。
是地下室那句玩笑。他原封不动还回来了。
Theo笑着说的，然后坐到了吧台另一头。

zh.hint: Theo装得跟没事人一样。可你手腕上，好像还留着他的温度。

opts.t: 你刚才在下面，话说一半。“其实我不想”——不想什么？
then: 哦。我想说，我不想……弄湿我的新鞋。

opts.t: 冲一杯热姜茶，推到他面前
then: Theo两只手捧着杯子，半天没再开玩笑。

opts.t: 都坐好。今晚停电，酒水我请。
then: 你俩能不能别每次都抢？
Theo又在抢单。五年了，一直这样。

zh: Wren掏出录音笔，红灯亮着。又把一个空酒瓶往吧台上一放。
反正走不了。来，转瓶子，真心话大冒险。
只许真心话。黑灯瞎火的，大冒险摔了还得我加班。
不关。这期就叫《暴雨夜，六个人的真心话》。

zh.hint: Wren把瓶子推给Theo：今晚他是主角，第一个转。转到谁，谁就得说真话。
win: 录下来了。这期能上热搜。
Theo把瓶子推开，耳朵尖有点红。
lose: 大家笑成一片。Theo也笑，可他偷偷瞄了Nico一眼。
skip: 我不转。我请大家喝一轮，买断。
钱不是万能的……行吧，酒是。

zh: Wren接过瓶子，用力一转。瓶口慢慢停下——对准了Mason。
Mason。上周决赛前一晚，到底怎么回事？
就这个。冷战一礼拜了，今晚不说开，谁都别想睡。

zh.hint: Wren要当众揭Mason和Ethan的伤疤，气氛一下僵了。这是你的店，你说了算。

opts.t: 让他们说。憋一礼拜了，再憋要出事。
换个问题吧，别逼人家。
then: Ethan一句话，把退路全堵死了。

opts.t: 先说好，打架的照价赔杯子。

zh: 规矩：你俩各讲一遍那天晚上。大家来猜，谁在撒谎。
那天训练完，他膝盖肿得跟馒头似的。我让他去医院，他不去。
然后我就回家睡觉了。教练怎么知道的，我不清楚。
那天晚上你根本不在家。我半夜起来拿冰袋，你屋里是空的。
第二天一早，教练就打电话，让我坐替补。

zh.hint: Mason和Ethan对“膝盖那晚”的说法对不上。听仔细了：谁在撒谎？
skip: 不用猜了。看Mason那张脸就知道。

zh: 说啊！你凭什么替我做决定？那是我的腿！我的决赛！
你知道坐在替补席上，看着全队输是什么感觉吗？
Mason猛地站起来，凳子“哐”一声倒在地上。
我宁可你恨我，也不想看你废一条腿——
Wren手忙脚乱地看录音笔：“在录在录！”
Rowan伸手，把她的录音笔按灭了。
Ethan愣在原地。脸红到了脖子根。
下一秒，他抓起外套，冲向门口。
门把手拧开了，雨一下子灌进来。Ethan却停住了，没回头。

zh.hint: Ethan站在门口，一只脚在雨里。Mason僵在原地，不敢追。

opts.t: 外面全淹了！你膝盖还要不要了？
then: Ethan的手在门把上攥了半天，把门关上了。
他没走回来，就在门边的楼梯上坐下了。

opts.t: 冲Mason使了个眼色：去啊！
then: Mason深吸一口气，走过去，把门轻轻关上。
Ethan在楼梯上坐下。Mason坐在他下面一级，谁都没说话。

opts.t: 什么都不说，给Ethan倒了杯热水
then: Nico把水杯放在门边的台阶上。
Ethan关上门，坐下，把杯子捧在手里。
过了一会儿，Mason也坐过去，隔了一级台阶。

zh: 这是我今晚看过最好的一场戏。我演了十年都没演过这么好的。
Wren在吧台底下踢了Nico一脚，用口型说：学着点。
她又把录音笔按开，转了一下瓶子。
瓶子转了好几圈，慢悠悠停下——瓶口对着Nico。
Nico。在场——有没有你喜欢的人？
全场一下安静了。所有人都看着Nico。尤其是Theo。

then: Theo手里的杯子停了。他没笑，就那么看着Nico。
这题简单。Nico心里只有他的酒吧。
else: 让他开个玩笑糊弄过去呗，他最会了。

zh.hint: 问题直戳心窝。录音笔开着，Theo就坐在对面。你怎么答？

opts.t: 没有。我只喜欢钱。
then: Theo跟着大家笑，笑完低头喝了一大口酒。

opts.t: 有。但我不说是谁。
then: Nico没回答。Theo的耳朵一点一点红了。

opts.t: 我答可以。Theo，你先答。
then: 两个人隔着蜡烛对视，谁都不先开口。
你俩是在比谁先憋死吗？

zh: 行了Wren，你今晚录的东西，够做一整季了。
这支笔我用了五年，里面什么都有。想不想听大学时候的？
看，他俩今晚第一次意见一致。
Wren往前翻录音，一堆笑声、碰杯声、跑调的歌。
找到了。五年前，话剧社谢幕那晚。
Wren，我警告你，那天我喝了半瓶二锅头……

zh.hint: Wren要放五年前的录音。Theo想拦，你是唯一能让她停下的人。

opts.t: 放吧。我也想听。
伸手去按停止键
then: Nico伸手去按，Wren一侧身躲开了。

opts.t: 二锅头？你大学就这么猛？

zh.txt: Nico！Nico你听着！以后不管我去哪儿，Nico的酒吧，我都会回来喝。说好了！
zh.hint: Wren的录音笔里，五年前话剧社谢幕那晚，喝多了的Theo。
then: 录音停了。没人说话，只剩雨声。
那时候Nico还没有酒吧呢。他天天念叨以后要开一家。
Theo低着头，一下一下抠着杯子上的标签。
skip: 行行行，不放。反正我听过一百遍了。
里面有人说，不管去哪儿，都会回来喝Nico的酒。

then: 你刚才在下面让我去。你说得对。
他笑着说的。可Nico听得出来，这是告别。

else: 放心，回来喝我也自己付钱，不跟你抢单。
还是那句玩笑。他一直记着。

zh.hint: 五年前那句“说好了”，现在又摆在你们面前。Theo就坐在对面。

opts.t: 醉话也算。说好了的，你得回来。
then: Nico张了张嘴，那个“要”字卡在喉咙里。

opts.t: 醉话嘛，不作数。
then: Wren在桌子底下狠狠掐了Nico一把。

opts.t: 低头剪蜡烛芯，假装没听见
then: Nico拿起剪刀，把烛芯一根根剪短。
Theo看了他好一会儿，没再说话。

zh: 他从Nico身边走过去，没回头，消失在黑漆漆的走廊里。
吧台上，他那杯酒一口没动。墙上的钟：11点55。

en.place: Halfmoon Bar — the bar top, by candlelight

en: Pitch black. Nothing but the rain hammering outside.
And the hand on Nico's wrist. Hot. Holding tight.
Nobody move. Nico — where are the candles?

en.hint: Someone in the dark is holding your wrist and not saying a word. You can't see who.

opts.t: Turn your hand and hold it back
then: The hand freezes for a second.
Nico's heart is going so hard he can hear it.

opts.t: ...Who is that?
then: A thumb brushes once across the bone of his wrist.

opts.t: Second drawer! I'll get them!
then: The hand lets go fast, like it got burned.

en: Click. Rowan's lighter catches, and the first candle flares.
The light jumps. Nico looks down. The hand on his wrist is Theo's.
Theo lets go instantly, shoves his hand in his pocket, looks away.
Floor's slippery. Didn't want you to fall.
Ohhh. Didn't want him to fall.
What? I'm not allowed to be a good guy?
Nico hauls out a whole box of scented candles. Zhou ordered them last year. Sold zero.
Lavender? Is this a bar or a foot spa?
I like it. Romantic. All we need is a proposal.
The second it's out, Theo chokes on it.
A ring of candles on the bar. The clock says 11:40. Everyone gathers around.

then: Theo holds up his phone: flight still says ON TIME.
See that? Even the universe wants me gone.
He says it breezily, and takes the seat farthest from Nico.
Down in the basement, Nico told him to go. Now it sits in Nico's chest like a stone.
Theo drops onto the stool right next to Nico, knee against knee.
Don't read into it. It's warmer here.
His hand a minute ago was hotter than any candle.
Wren's shoulders are shaking from holding in a laugh.
else: Nico, open the priciest bottle. Nobody's gonna fight you for the check anymore, right?
It's Nico's joke from the basement. Returned word for word.
Theo's smiling when he says it. Then he sits at the far end of the bar.

en.hint: Theo's acting like nothing happened. Your wrist still feels warm where he held it.

opts.t: You stopped halfway down there. "I don't want to" — want to what?
then: Oh. I meant I didn't want to... get my new shoes wet.

opts.t: Make a hot ginger tea and slide it over to him
then: A bar that serves ginger tea?
Theo wraps both hands around the mug. For once, no joke.

opts.t: Sit down, everybody. Blackout special — drinks are on me.
then: Can you two not fight over the tab every single time?
Theo's grabbing the check again. Five years, every time.

en: Wren pulls out her recorder, red light on. Then sets an empty bottle on the bar.
We're stuck anyway. Spin the bottle. Truth or dare.
Truth only. Somebody does a dare in the dark and breaks something, I'm working overtime.
Wren, can you turn that thing off?
Nope. This episode is called "Six Friends, One Flood, All Truth."
Guest of honor goes first. Theo, spin.

en.hint: Wren pushes the bottle to Theo. He's the guest of honor, so he spins first. Whoever it lands on tells the truth.
win: Okay, okay. This round, I lose.
Got it on tape. This episode's going viral.
Theo pushes the bottle away. The tips of his ears are red.
lose: Everyone cracks up. Theo laughs too, but he sneaks a look at Nico.
skip: I'm not spinning. I'll buy a round instead. Buyout.
Money can't buy everything... fine, booze can.

en: Wren takes the bottle and spins hard. It slows... and points at Mason.
Mason. The night before the final. What actually happened?
Ethan's glass stops halfway to his mouth.
Nope. They've been frozen for a week. Nobody sleeps till this gets settled.

en.hint: Wren's about to rip the scab off Mason and Ethan in front of everyone. It's your bar. Your call.

opts.t: Let them talk. A week of this — any longer and someone's gonna snap.
then: Mason glances at Nico. He doesn't argue.

opts.t: Ask something else. Don't push them.
then: I want to hear what he says.
One sentence, and Ethan's shut every way out.

opts.t: Ground rules: you fight, you pay for the glasses.
then: I'll go grab the ice packs.

en: Rules: you each tell us about that night. We guess who's lying.
After practice his knee was swollen like a softball. I told him to go to the ER. He wouldn't.
Then I went home and went to sleep. No idea how Coach found out.
You weren't home. I got up at midnight for ice and your room was empty.
First thing next morning, Coach calls and benches me.

en.hint: Mason and Ethan's stories about "knee night" don't match. Listen closely: who's lying?
then: He stares into his glass, then knocks it back.
skip: Don't even need to guess. Look at Mason's face.

en: Ethan slaps the bar and stands up.
Say it! Who gave you the right to decide for me? It's my knee! My final!
You know what it's like sitting on the bench, watching the whole team lose?
Mason shoots to his feet. His stool crashes to the floor.

en.title: Mason Says It
en.txt: "Yes, I told him! Because I like you!"

en: I'd rather you hate me than watch you wreck your knee —
— because I like you! Happy now?
Wren fumbles for her recorder. "It's rolling, it's rolling!"
Rowan reaches over and clicks it off.
Ethan stands frozen, red all the way down his neck.
Then he grabs his coat and bolts for the door.
The handle turns and rain blasts in. But Ethan stops. Doesn't turn around.

en.hint: Ethan's in the doorway, one foot in the rain. Mason's frozen, too scared to follow.

opts.t: It's flooded out there! You want to lose the knee for real?
then: Ethan's grip tightens on the handle. Then he pulls the door shut.
He doesn't come back. He just sits down on the stairs by the door.

opts.t: Shoot Mason a look: go!
then: Mason takes a breath, walks over, and quietly shuts the door.
Ethan sits on the stairs. Mason sits one step below him. Neither says a word.

opts.t: Say nothing. Pour Ethan a glass of hot water
then: Nico sets the glass on the step by the door.
Ethan shuts the door, sits, and holds the glass in both hands.
After a minute Mason sits down too, one step below.

en: You like me... and you couldn't say so sooner?
I still kind of want to.
Best show I've seen all night. Ten years of acting and I've never been that good.
Under the bar, Wren kicks Nico and mouths: take notes.
She clicks the recorder back on and spins the bottle again.
It spins and spins, slows... and stops pointing at Nico.
Ooh. The boss hits the jackpot.
Nico. Is there someone here — in this room — that you like?
The room goes dead quiet. Everyone's looking at Nico. Especially Theo.

then: Theo's glass stops. He's not smiling. He's just watching Nico.
Easy one. The only thing Nico loves is this bar.
He says it with a grin, but he doesn't look at Nico.
else: He'll just crack a joke and dodge it. It's his specialty.

en.hint: Straight to the heart. The recorder's on, and Theo's right across from you. What do you say?

opts.t: Nope. I only love money.
then: Liar. Fine, we'll let it slide.
Theo laughs along with everyone, then takes a long drink.

opts.t: Yes. But I'm not saying who.
then: Wren shrieks. Rowan clamps a hand over her mouth.
Theo's glass stops at his lips.
Nico doesn't answer. Theo's ears go red, slowly.

opts.t: I'll answer. But Theo goes first.
then: Me? The bottle didn't land on me.
...You say it, then I'll say it.
They stare at each other across the candles. Neither goes first.
Are you two competing to see who dies of repression first?

en: Okay, Wren. You've got enough tape tonight for a whole season.
I've had this recorder five years. There's everything on here. Want to hear college stuff?
Look at that. First thing they've agreed on all night.
Wren scrolls back. Laughter, clinking glasses, off-key singing.
Here. Five years ago. Closing night, drama club.
Wren, I'm warning you. I drank half a bottle of baijiu that night...

en.hint: Wren's about to play a five-year-old recording. Theo wants it stopped — and you're the only one she'd listen to.

opts.t: Play it. I want to hear.
then: Theo protests, but he doesn't reach for it.

opts.t: Reach for the stop button
then: Nico reaches. Wren twists out of the way.

opts.t: Baijiu? You were that hardcore in college?

en.txt: Nico! Nico, listen! Wherever I end up, I'm coming back to drink at Nico's bar. Deal!
en.hint: On Wren's recorder: drunk Theo, five years ago, on drama club's closing night.
then: The recording ends. No one speaks. Just rain.
Nico didn't even have a bar back then. He just kept saying he'd open one someday.
Theo stares down, picking at the label on his glass.
skip: Fine, fine, I won't. I've heard it a hundred times anyway.
Someone on here says wherever he goes, he's coming back to drink at Nico's.

then: You told me to go, down there. You're right.
I'll come back for a drink.
He's smiling. But Nico can hear it: that was goodbye.
Theo looks up at Nico across the candles.
That thing you said in the basement...
else: Don't worry. When I come back I'll pay my own tab. Won't fight you for it.
That joke again. He's been holding onto it.

en.hint: Five years ago he said "deal." Now it's sitting between you again, and he's right across the bar.

opts.t: Drunk talk counts. A deal's a deal. You have to come back.
then: Theo looks at Nico for a long time.
Nico opens his mouth. The "yes" gets stuck in his throat.

opts.t: Drunk talk. It doesn't count.
then: Under the bar, Wren pinches Nico hard.

opts.t: Look down, trim a candle wick, pretend you didn't hear
then: Nico picks up the scissors and trims the wicks, one by one.
Theo watches him for a while. Says nothing.

en: Theo sets down his glass and stands up.
He walks right past Nico without looking back, and disappears down the dark hallway.
On the bar, his drink sits untouched. The clock reads 11:55.
